semantics.confirmed: Scheduled input arrival to first original successful committed Social receipt associated through the actual model call key; includes queueing. A coalesced receipt can confirm multiple observed inputs.
semantics.handler: Actual processor.handle entry to return; may precede a coalesced producer. Means weighted by input count. Per-run P95 is not a pooled P95.
semantics.sql: SQLAlchemy Engine events; native pre_ping and implicit SQLite BEGIN are absent. Not all native statements.
semantics.writer: Entry includes checkout/BEGIN; explicit scopes only. Baseline mixed scopes absent. Acknowledged-write interval starts after first successful DML or explicit BEGIN; not equivalent total hold semantics.
semantics.callback: 20Hz observer thread posts a callback; measures posting-to-dispatch delay, excludes GIL delay before posting. Per-run summaries, not continuous maximum stall.
semantics.environment: Windows local synthetic fixture, fixed FakeLLM and in-memory platform; no real requests. Two logical CPUs selected only for cpu2 cases. Old/new/new/old, no run discarded.
